capabilities: Edit mind map nodes in the Obsidian editor
Store maps as plain Markdown outline files
Mark Now and Minor nodes and filter to key points
Drill into a node tree and save it as a shortcut
Fold or unfold to a chosen level
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown outliner or canvas replacement; it renders a strict tree mind map with no connectors or summary frames.
extras: Desktop only; no mobile support planned on a fixed timeline. 14-day full-feature trial, then a free tier for general editing plus a paid Pro tier (early-bird 48 CNY, one-time, 3 devices) for the focus, shortcut, folding and AI-rule features. README states no data collection and no external API calls; a 200,000-character map reportedly loads in about 2 seconds. License text restricts redistribution and commercial resale.
problem: Mind map tools store maps in proprietary formats that AI agents cannot read or edit, and large maps become cluttered and hard to navigate.

requires.name: one-time license activation for Now, Minor, shortcuts, AI location path and level folding

summary: Markdown-based mind map plugin that edits outline maps in the Obsidian editor and keeps them readable and editable by AI agents.
